strategies.name: pre_market_high_low_breakout_retest_liquidity_sweep_strategy
strategies.entry_summary: On the 5-minute chart, mark the pre-market high and low from 3:00 a.m. EST until the New York open. Trade when price reaches one of those levels via a clean breakout, a break-and-retest, or a liquidity sweep/reclaim after the level is taken.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop on the opposite side of the entry candle or below/above the level being traded. Manage profit by taking at least 1R and ideally 1.5R-2R+, then trail the stop toward breakeven or into profit and scale out as the move extends.
